thread:
alex.s: Heads-up — planning to run the users.email_index migration and staggered backfill in the evening slot tonight (23:30 UTC). Dual-write window requested for 30m. @tara.k can you own the deploy and rollback readiness?
tara.k: I can take deploy ownership. Will be on call from 23:15–00:15 UTC. Who's doing smoke checks? @ben.l? :eyes:
ben.l: I'll run smoke + quick query perf checks. Plan: smoke at +5m, latency check at +10m, backfill tailing at +20m. Command snippets below i'll run in prod-checks:```psql -h users-db-ro -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE email IS NULL;"
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.io/health | jq '.latency'```
alex.s: Thanks. Migration steps: 1) deploy schema change (non-blocking), 2) enable dual-write flag for 30m, 3) start backfill job with rate limit, 4) monitor for 5xx or index bloat. If any 5xx spike => rollback dual-write and pause backfill.
maria.c: I'm on metrics — will watch token-level latency, db_cpu, and replica_lag dashboards. I'll post thresholds if any hit 2x baseline.
tara.k: Rollback plan confirmed: revert feature flag + cut traffic to old worker pool. If revert doesn't stop errors within 3m, escalate to @sre-oncall for DB failover / read-scaling.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: users.email_index migration
Start: 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z
Owner: tara.k
Window: 30m :rocket:
ben.l: Quick note — backfill will run in small batches `LIMIT 5000` with 1s sleep between batches to avoid replica lag. I'll have the backfill PID in case we need to kill it.
alex.s: Can we add a smoke checklist in the thread? Short: 1) app writes ok (dual-write verification) 2) no 5xx 3) p95 token latency < 250ms 4) replica_lag < 10s
maria.c: Added alert thresholds to my dashboard. I'll ping here if anything crosses.
tara.k: Got it. I'll post `deploy start` and `deploy done` in this thread. If anyone needs to jump in, ping me. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: I'll be available for escalations 23:30–00:30 UTC. If we hit sustained DB CPU > 80% I'll step in to scale read replicas.
ben.l: OK starting preflight now: running migrations locally + dry run on staging. Will post preflight diff in ~10m.
alex.s: Thanks team — keeping window tight. If all green, we close by 00:00 UTC.
